recentItems.title: స్టార్‌లింక్ ఇంటర్నెట్ స్పీడ్‌ను నేనే తగ్గించా | Musk Admits Throttling Starlink Speeds In Ukraine
recentItems.description:
SpaceX founder and tech billionaire Elon Musk has publicly confirmed that his company deliberately throttled Starlink satellite internet speeds across Ukraine over the past week, precipitating widespread operational disruptions along the active front line. Posting on X following the restoration of service, Musk declared that commercial civilian connectivity was never permitted to be weaponized for lethal offensive drone operations. While defending SpaceX’s foundational support for Ukrainian defense since February 2022, Musk asserted that closing the operational loophole was necessary, while clarifying that military-grade Starshield systems remain administered under Pentagon authority. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy confirmed that following intensive bilateral diplomacy with the Trump administration, full broadband speeds were restored overnight, immediately rehabilitating frontline logistics and drone interception networks targeting Russian Shahed drones. The incident has exposed profound tensions between Kyiv and Washington amid conflicting statements from Donald Trump, J.D. Vance, and defense officials regarding White House involvement. Meanwhile, deep cross-border strikes escalated as Ukrainian drones penetrated western Siberia over 2,000 kilometers away, striking Russian rocket fuel chemical facilities in Tolyatti and electronics plants in Oryol. This straight-angle Telugu video explainer examines the defense implications, geopolitical friction, and perils of private corporate control over wartime communications.
#ElonMusk #Starlink #UkraineWar #etvdigital
